newsitem.title: USA: Four U.S. Swissotels up for sale - report.
newsitem.headline: Four U.S. Swissotels up for sale - report.

text.p: Boston's Swissotel is up for sale along with three other U.S. hotels in the Swissotel North American chain, the Boston Business Journal reported on Friday.

Under the proposed sale package, SAirGroup, the Zurich-based holding company formerly known as Swissair, would sell its four U.S. hotels but retain management and the Swissotel name, Robert Webster, executive vice president of the Atlanta, Georgia-based Hodges Ward Elliott Inc, the firm brokering the deal, told the weekly business journal.
Webster said the company is asking "in the ballpark" of $465 million for its four U.S. properties located in Boston, Atlanta, Chicago and New York.
Webster could not be immediately reached for comment.
